snippet.title: KEEP LOOKING Trailer
snippet.description:
#KEEPLOOKING is a nerve-wracking horror game that puts you in a dark, claustrophobic cave with a relentless creature. Survive by flashing your dying flashlight at the right moments—too soon or too late, and it’s over. You must keep an eye on the creature, but beware: staring too long is just as deadly.

Play for free on Steam today!
